tiktok.body:
these are the apps i swear by as an accel nursing student! these save me so much time and help me study smarter, not harder!!🩺📚 what apps do you use?👇 #acceleratednursing #nursingstudent #absn #jungle #studentnurse
These are the four apps that have helped me study more efficiently and save time as an accelerated nursing student. The first app is ChatGPT, and honestly, this has become my personal nursing tutor. Whenever I don't understand a concept, I ask it to explain it in different ways until it finally clicks. The second app is jungle, and it's become a part of every single study session. Instead of spending a ton of time making my own flashcards or quizzes, I upload lecture slides and it automatically creates practice questions from my material. And the last app is Notebook LM and my favorite feature, honestly, is the podcast. I'll upload my lecture slides or study guides and it creates a podcast style conversation based on my notes. Instead of staring at another Powerpoint, I can listen to my material while I'm driving, getting ready in the morning, cleaning my room, or even walking on the treadmill. These apps definitely don't replace studying, but they help me spend less time organizing and more time learning.

tiktok.author: bri.michelle_
tiktok.body:
TOP 5 AGENCY APP’S TO CHECK OUT! None of these are in a specific order and I’m not saying they are the best apps out there. These are just a few to check out. #nursinglife #nurselife #cna #nursingstudent #nursetok
Come here! I heard the girlies wanted to know the top 5 apps to check out. The first one I'll recommend is clipboard. Um, I actually utilize that app myself quite frequently and what I like about clipboard is you know it is different pay rates depending on your location, but also same day payout. Clap it up for same day payout. Number two I'm gonna say shift Med and CNAS nurses can all find shifts on this app. And depending on where you're located you could be working at a hospital, a clinic, a rehab centre, basically variety of places. It's just state based. Number three I'm gonna say is Intelycare, and I love that app back home in Connecticut because they have the best shifts and the best rates. Um, not as much shifts down here in the south. Um, I see like one facility up there, but they do still pay good, but it's just farther out so I don't bother to go. Number four is Nursa. I actually didn't get a chance to utilize this app because at first it was a little bit confusing. I think it's still a little bit confusing, but I hear people talk about it all the time and I hear that they actually pay really good. So if you're interested in learning about Nursa, definitely do your more research on them. No.5 is gonna be carerev, and I briefly heard about carerev. but I can't really speak on It because I don't really utilize that app. Um, L P N's, R N's, C N A's can all pick up shifts on this app as well. Just keep in mind that every app is not gonna have the same rate, the same shifts. It varies state by state. So just download a few apps and see what works best for you and what offers more money. If you're already working agency ladies, drop in the comments what agency you work at, because I know there's more out there. Remember, we're diving deep, and we're not gatekeeping
